limits: Same mux timeline does not measure A/V, instrument or engine-event latency
Parked/zero indicated speed and low bar do not establish warm idle or source isolation
Frame sampling does not rule out every intervening edit or short action
Acoustic spacing is not physical engine-cycle frequency or ECU RPM
